cohort: 104 pregnant females aged 18-40 years with gestational age > 24 weeks and a positive diagnosis of HCV or HBV.
finding: Pregnant females with hepatitis infection had an increased risk of intrauterine death, fetal distress, and emergency cesarean delivery, as well as a high percentage of low birth weight, premature births, and preterm labor.
mod_finding: Emergency C-section was performed for 72 (30.8%) women.
